metadata.exam-title: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional
metadata.description: Scenario-Based Study Guide for AIP-C01 certification - validates ability to develop generative AI applications using AWS services including Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and related AI/ML tools.

question.title: Question 1
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which AWS service provides managed access to multiple foundation models through a single API?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Amazon Bedrock provides managed access to multiple foundation models through a unified API. SageMaker Studio is a development environment, EC2 is raw compute, and Lambda is event-driven compute.

question.title: Question 2
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: In a retrieval-augmented generation architecture, what is the main purpose of embeddings?

choices.choice: Compress prompts to reduce token count
Represent content numerically for semantic search

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Embeddings convert text or other content into vectors that support semantic similarity search. They are not primarily for encryption, JSON formatting, or prompt compression.

question.title: Question 3
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: A team wants the lowest operational overhead for calling large language models from AWS applications. Which approach best fits?

choices.choice: Host open-weight models manually on EC2
Run models from containers in ECS with GPU nodes
Install a model directly inside Lambda

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Amazon Bedrock minimizes operational overhead by abstracting infrastructure and exposing managed model APIs. EC2 and ECS require more direct infrastructure management, and Lambda is not suitable for hosting large models directly.

question.title: Question 4
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which AWS capability is most directly used to restrict a Bedrock-based application so it can call only specific model actions?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: IAM policies control access to AWS APIs and actions, including Bedrock-related permissions. Security groups control network traffic, Route 53 health checks monitor endpoints, and Shield Advanced mitigates DDoS attacks.

question.title: Question 5
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the main benefit of grounding a model with retrieved enterprise documents?

choices.choice: It improves answer relevance using trusted context
It replaces the need for access control

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Grounding with enterprise documents improves relevance by supplying trusted context at inference time. It does not eliminate token costs, guarantee zero latency, or replace authorization controls.

hint.label: Deep Knowledge
hint.content: Improves relevance and reduces unsupported answers

question.title: Question 6
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which metric is most useful when evaluating whether a generative AI system is too expensive in production?

choices.choice: Cost per successful task or response

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Cost per successful task or response ties infrastructure and token spend to actual delivered value. Subnet count, AZ count, and IAM user count do not directly measure production economics.

question.title: Question 7
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which technique most directly reduces hallucinations in a question-answering application over internal documents?

choices.choice: Add retrieval and require source-backed answers
Shorten all prompts to under 20 tokens

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Retrieval-augmented generation with source-backed responses reduces hallucinations by grounding the model in relevant documents. Higher temperature usually increases variability, prompt shortening alone is insufficient, and disabling logging does nothing to improve factuality.

question.title: Question 8
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: When comparing prompts for the same task, what is the best way to measure prompt quality?

choices.choice: Use only whichever prompt is shorter
Evaluate outputs against defined task-specific criteria
Choose the prompt with the most system text
Pick the prompt that uses the newest model name

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Prompt quality should be measured against explicit criteria such as accuracy, completeness, format compliance, and latency. Prompt length or model recency alone does not establish quality.

question.title: Question 9
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the main tradeoff when selecting a larger context window model?

choices.choice: Lower relevance but no cost change
Ability to process more context, often with higher latency or cost
Automatic elimination of prompt injection risk

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Models with larger context windows can process more information, but that often increases latency and token-related cost. They do not remove IAM needs or prompt injection risks.

hint.label: Deep Knowledge
hint.content: Higher context capacity often costs more

question.title: Question 10
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: For a Bedrock application that must not expose sensitive prompts or responses publicly, what is the best first control?

choices.choice: Store outputs in a public S3 bucket
Apply least-privilege access and private data handling controls

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Least-privilege access and private data handling are foundational controls for preventing unintended exposure. Public S3 storage would increase risk, and changing temperature or disabling CloudWatch would not address core security needs.

question.title: Question 11
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the main purpose of a vector store in a generative AI application?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: A vector store holds embeddings and supports similarity search for retrieval workflows. It does not train models, replace IAM, or provide DNS.

question.title: Question 12
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: A developer wants structured JSON output from a model. What usually improves reliability most?

choices.choice: Explicitly define the required output schema in the prompt
Send a much longer unrelated context block

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Specifying the exact schema or output structure improves reliability for structured responses. Higher randomness and unrelated context reduce consistency, not increase it.

question.title: Question 13
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which situation most strongly suggests fine-tuning instead of prompt-only adaptation?

choices.choice: The team wants a shorter URL
The model must consistently adopt specialized behavior not achieved reliably through prompting alone
The application needs fewer IAM roles
The team wants to avoid all evaluation work

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Fine-tuning is appropriate when prompt engineering alone cannot reliably produce the needed specialized behavior. It does not solve IAM design or eliminate evaluation requirements.

question.title: Question 14
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is prompt injection in the context of generative AI security?

choices.choice: Malicious instructions hidden in input or retrieved content to alter model behavior

hint.label: Brief Hint
hint.content: It is a model-input attack pattern

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Prompt injection occurs when attacker-controlled content includes instructions that manipulate the model's behavior. It is not compression, encryption, or token budgeting.

question.title: Question 15
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which design best supports auditing of prompts, responses, and application behavior over time?

choices.choice: Capture structured logs and evaluation metadata securely
Store nothing unless a failure is reported manually

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Structured, secure logging and evaluation metadata provide auditability and support troubleshooting and governance. Disabling telemetry or relying only on ephemeral browser memory prevents effective auditing.

question.title: Question 16
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Why would a team chunk documents before embedding them?

choices.choice: To improve retrieval granularity and relevance
To force the model to ignore context

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Chunking breaks documents into useful units for embedding and retrieval, improving relevance and making context windows more efficient. It does not disable search or affect IAM policy size.

question.title: Question 17
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the main reason to test a generative AI application with adversarial prompts?

choices.choice: To assess robustness against unsafe or manipulated inputs

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Adversarial testing helps determine how safely and reliably the system behaves under hostile or manipulative conditions. It does not optimize storage or AZ usage.

question.title: Question 18
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which output characteristic is most important when a model is generating SQL or code for downstream execution?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: When generated SQL or code will be executed, correctness is critical. Creativity, verbosity, or style are secondary.

hint.label: Deep Knowledge
hint.content: Syntax and semantics must be correct

question.title: Question 19
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which practice most directly helps control runaway inference cost?

choices.choice: Increase max output tokens without limit
Set reasonable token limits and monitor usage patterns

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Reasonable token limits and usage monitoring help prevent unexpectedly large inference costs. Unlimited output and duplicate requests increase spend, not control it.

question.title: Question 20
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which factor is most relevant when deciding whether to use a smaller model for a production task?

choices.choice: Whether the model name sounds modern
Whether it meets quality requirements at lower cost or latency
Whether it removes all security requirements
Whether it avoids any need for prompts

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: A smaller model is a good choice if it satisfies quality thresholds while reducing cost or latency. Model branding or unrealistic assumptions about security and prompting are not sound selection criteria.

question.title: Question 21
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the most useful reason to maintain a benchmark dataset for a generative AI application?

choices.choice: To compare model, prompt, and system changes consistently over time
To remove the need for logging

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: A benchmark dataset enables consistent comparison across models, prompts, and system revisions. It does not replace security or observability practices.

question.title: Question 22
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which approach best protects sensitive enterprise data used in a generative AI workflow?

choices.choice: Share all prompts publicly for review
Apply encryption, access controls, and data minimization
Store source documents in anonymous paste sites

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Protecting sensitive enterprise data requires encryption, access control, and minimizing unnecessary exposure. Public sharing and disabling identity checks would increase risk substantially.

question.title: Question 23
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Why might a team use caching in a generative AI application?

choices.choice: To reduce latency and repeated inference cost for identical or near-identical requests
To remove the need for IAM roles

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Caching can reduce both latency and cost when requests repeat or are sufficiently similar. It does not replace vector search in retrieval scenarios or eliminate identity and access requirements.

question.title: Question 24
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which evaluation result most strongly suggests that a prompt revision improved a summarization system?

choices.choice: Outputs became longer regardless of relevance
Outputs more consistently preserved key facts while reducing unsupported claims

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: An improved summarization system should preserve key facts and reduce unsupported claims. Log size and subnet count are not direct indicators of summary quality.

hint.label: Deep Knowledge
hint.content: Improved fact preservation and reduced hallucination

question.title: Question 25
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: For a production generative AI system, which practice is most important before rolling out a new prompt version widely?

choices.choice: Test the new prompt against representative workloads and evaluation cases
Increase temperature to maximum by default

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Before broad rollout, a new prompt version should be tested against representative cases to verify quality, safety, and reliability. Disabling authentication or maximizing temperature would increase risk rather than reduce it.

question.title: Question 26
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the primary purpose of temperature in text generation?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Temperature affects how deterministic or creative outputs are. Higher values increase randomness; lower values make outputs more predictable.

question.title: Question 27
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is a key benefit of using top-k or top-p sampling?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Top-k and top-p sampling constrain token selection, balancing diversity and coherence. They do not guarantee correctness or eliminate hallucinations.

question.title: Question 28
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which scenario most benefits from streaming model responses?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Streaming responses improves perceived latency in interactive applications by delivering tokens incrementally.

question.title: Question 29
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the main purpose of guardrails in a generative AI system?

choices.choice: Constrain outputs to safe and acceptable boundaries

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Guardrails help enforce safety, compliance, and content restrictions on model outputs.

question.title: Question 30
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which AWS service is commonly used to store embeddings for similarity search?

choices.choice: A vector-capable database or search service

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Embeddings are typically stored in vector databases or search systems optimized for similarity queries.

question.title: Question 31
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the primary risk of not validating model outputs?

choices.choice: Propagation of incorrect or unsafe results

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Without validation, incorrect or harmful outputs can propagate into systems or users.

question.title: Question 32
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which technique improves consistency in repeated model calls?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Lower temperature reduces randomness and improves consistency across calls.

question.title: Question 33
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Why is prompt versioning important?

choices.choice: To track changes and compare performance over time

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Prompt versioning allows controlled experimentation and rollback when needed.

question.title: Question 34
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the main function of a system prompt?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: A system prompt sets the role, tone, and constraints for the model.

question.title: Question 35
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which factor most impacts latency in LLM responses?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Latency is heavily influenced by model size and the number of tokens processed.

question.title: Question 36

question.question-text: What is the purpose of max tokens parameter?

question.title: Question 37
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which practice improves reliability of tool-calling workflows?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Structured schemas improve reliability in tool-calling and integrations.

question.title: Question 38
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the main advantage of batching requests?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Batching improves throughput and cost efficiency in many scenarios.

question.title: Question 39
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which risk is associated with over-long prompts?

choices.choice: Higher cost and possible context dilution

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Long prompts increase cost and can dilute important context.

question.title: Question 40
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the primary purpose of evaluation pipelines?

question.title: Question 41
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which design reduces repeated embedding computation?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Caching embeddings avoids repeated expensive computation.

question.title: Question 42
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the main reason to use a fallback model?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Fallback models improve system resilience when primary models fail.

question.title: Question 43
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: Which factor is most important when selecting embedding models?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Embedding model quality determines retrieval effectiveness.

question.title: Question 44
question.scenario: You are preparing for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the purpose of response truncation?

hint.content: Truncation ensures outputs stay within limits.

question.question-text: What is the benefit of rate limiting in AI APIs?

question.title: Question 47

question.question-text: Which factor most impacts retrieval accuracy?

choices.choice: Deliver reliable, cost-effective value to users
